integrity.description: The survey elements are manually placed/drawn relative to the specific floorplan geometry.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The original floorplan.dxf contains 967 entities and 24 layers, featuring a 2-car garage and residential rooms. The final output must be named floorplan_survey.dxf. Setbacks must be 20 units (front/rear) and 5 units (sides). Bearings must follow the 'N/S degrees E/W' format. The utility easement must specifically use a dashed linetype.
